# Abbreviations, Symbols, and Units {.unnumbered}

Mission-critical data center EPC delivery intersects turnkey contract law, thermodynamic heat-transfer physics, high-voltage power engineering, life-safety codes, and structured quantity surveying [@fidic2017silver; @rics2021nrm2; @bicsi2024002]. This front-matter reference consolidates all acronyms, mathematical symbols, and cross-regional measurement unit conversions used across Volumes I through VII.

## Abbreviations and Acronyms {.unnumbered}

As cataloged in @tbl-abbreviations, each acronym links directly to its full technical and commercial measurement definition in the back-matter Glossary and to the primary chapter or table where it is governed.

## SI and Imperial Measurement Unit Conversions {.unnumbered}

Hyperscale Employer's Project Requirements and Basis of Design documents authored in North America frequently specify duties in US Customary / Imperial units, whereas UK, European, and GCC Bills of Quantities prepared under RICS NRM2 measure works in metric SI units [@rics2021nrm2; @ref37_aecom_meh2024]. @tbl-unit-conversions establishes the conversion baseline used for commercial bid leveling and takeoff verification.
